name: sql-format-vscode
description: Format T-SQL using sql-format with RedGate-compatible JSON style configs

sqlFormat.checkForUpdates.markdownDescription: Automatically check the [GitHub releases](https://github.com/bowermandw/sql-format/releases) for a newer version of this extension on startup (at most once per day) and offer to install it. Run the **T-SQL Format: Check for Updates** command to check manually at any time.

sqlFormat.styleFile.markdownDescription: Path to a JSON style configuration file (RedGate-compatible). Relative paths resolve against the document's workspace folder. Leave empty to use defaults or auto-detection.

sqlFormat.autoDetectStyleFile.markdownDescription: When `#sqlFormat.styleFile#` is not set, look for a `.sqlformat.json` file in the workspace root and use it if present.

enumDescriptions: Use the value from the style config (or built-in default).
sqlFormat.encloseIdentifiers.markdownDescription: Override the style config's identifier bracketing (CLI `--enclose-identifiers`). `default` leaves the style config untouched.

enumDescriptions: Use the value from the style config (or built-in default).
sqlFormat.encloseDataTypes.markdownDescription: Override the style config's data-type bracketing (CLI `--enclose-datatypes`). `default` leaves the style config untouched.

enumDescriptions: Use the value from the style config (or built-in default).
Insert a semicolon after each statement.
sqlFormat.insertSemicolons.markdownDescription: Override the style config's statement-terminator handling (CLI `--insert-semicolons`). `default` leaves the style config untouched.

enumDescriptions: Use the value from the style config (or built-in default).
sqlFormat.lineEnding.markdownDescription: Override the style config's line-ending style (CLI `--line-ending`). `default` leaves the style config untouched.

sqlFormat.warnMissingSchema.markdownDescription: Warn when a table, view, or stored-procedure reference has no schema prefix (CLI `--warn-missing-schema`). Shown as a squiggle and in the Problems panel.

sqlFormat.warnMissingAlias.markdownDescription: Warn when a table or view in a `FROM`/`JOIN` clause has no alias (CLI `--warn-missing-alias`). Shown as a squiggle and in the Problems panel.

sqlFormat.warnMissingNocount.markdownDescription: Warn when a stored procedure body does not contain `SET NOCOUNT ON` (CLI `--warn-missing-nocount`). Shown as a squiggle and in the Problems panel.

sqlFormat.warnMissingNullability.markdownDescription: Warn when a temp-table or table-variable column omits `NULL` / `NOT NULL` (CLI `--warn-missing-nullability`). Shown as a squiggle and in the Problems panel.

sqlFormat.checkInsertColumns.markdownDescription: Show the `INSERT ... SELECT` column mapping and flag count/name mismatches (CLI `--check-insert-columns`). Shown in the Problems panel.
